mapper.select: SELECT toString(ref_sample.stable_id) AS reference_sample_id, toString(portal_sample.stable_id) AS sample_id, part.part_key AS part_key, part.part_number AS part_number, part.part_designator AS part_designator, part.part_type AS part_type, part.part_description AS part_description, part.subspecialty AS subspecialty, part.path_dx_title AS path_dx_title, block.block_key AS block_key, block.block_number AS block_number, block.block_label AS block_label, slide.image_id AS image_id, slide.stain_name AS stain_name, slide.stain_group AS stain_group, slide.is_hne AS is_hne, slide.is_ihc AS is_ihc, slide.magnification AS magnification, slide.file_size_bytes AS file_size_bytes, ( slide.can_serve_tiles AND notEmpty(ifNull(slide.source_url, '')) AND notEmpty(ifNull(slide.tile_metadata_json, '')) AND notEmpty(ifNull(slide.thumbnail_url, '')) AND slide.thumbnail_width > 0 AND slide.thumbnail_height > 0 ) AS can_serve_tiles, slide.barcode AS barcode, slide.slide_type AS slide_type, placement.match_level AS match_level, placement.specimen_key AS specimen_key, placement.procedure_date_days AS procedure_date_days, placement.timepoint_source AS timepoint_source FROM cancer_study study INNER JOIN patient portal_patient ON portal_patient.cancer_study_id = study.cancer_study_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT cancer_study_id, argMax(release_id, (released_at, release_id)) AS release_id FROM wsi_release GROUP BY cancer_study_id ) active_release ON active_release.cancer_study_id = study.cancer_study_id INNER JOIN wsi_release_patient ps ON ps.cancer_study_id = active_release.cancer_study_id AND ps.release_id = active_release.release_id AND ps.patient_id = portal_patient.internal_id LEFT JOIN sample ref_sample ON ref_sample.internal_id = ps.reference_sample_id LEFT JOIN wsi_part part ON part.cancer_study_id = ps.cancer_study_id AND part.patient_id = ps.patient_id AND part.release_id = ps.release_id LEFT JOIN wsi_block block ON block.cancer_study_id = part.cancer_study_id AND block.patient_id = part.patient_id AND block.release_id = part.release_id AND block.part_key = part.part_key LEFT JOIN wsi_slide_placement placement ON placement.cancer_study_id = block.cancer_study_id AND placement.patient_id = block.patient_id AND placement.release_id = block.release_id AND placement.part_key = block.part_key AND placement.block_key = block.block_key LEFT JOIN wsi_slide slide ON slide.cancer_study_id = placement.cancer_study_id AND slide.patient_id = placement.patient_id AND slide.release_id = placement.release_id AND slide.image_id = placement.image_id LEFT JOIN sample portal_sample ON portal_sample.internal_id = placement.sample_id WHERE study.cancer_study_identifier = #{studyId} AND portal_patient.stable_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY sample_id, part.part_key, block.block_key, slide.image_id
